Solo - standing, still.label: Solo - standing, still
Solo - standing, still.brief: {A} stands still in place, weight even, arms loose at the sides, chin level and eyes to the lens; the camera is a static medium shot with the whole body in frame.

Solo - walking toward camera.label: Solo - walking toward camera
Solo - walking toward camera.brief: {A} walks slowly toward the camera, arms swinging naturally, hips leading; the camera retreats at the same pace so the body stays the same size in frame.

Solo - turning in place.label: Solo - turning in place
Solo - turning in place.brief: {A} turns slowly on the spot from front to profile to back and round again, arms slack; the camera holds a static wide frame.

Solo - seated on a chair.label: Solo - seated on a chair
Solo - seated on a chair.brief: {A} sits upright on a chair, hands on the knees, one ankle behind the other, eyes to the lens; the camera is static at chest height.
